quality_highlights.aspect: All three status messages follow the gold-standard pattern. run-failure uses {status} to surface the actual failure reason; no exclamation marks on failure; no decorative trailing emojis.
Consistent heading hierarchy per release, concrete CLI code examples with flags shown in context, 'Usage tip' box pairs observation with actionable next step.

single_file_improvements.issue: Starter metrics list appears 3 times in prose with slight variations across sections. No structured table or list to allow scanning. Add a metrics table in 'A Practical Measurement Model' section.

run-failure uses 'interrupted!' — inaccurate (implies external cancellation), exclamation mark is wrong tone for failure, trailing '...' adds no information. Fix: 'Task mining failed. [{workflow_name}]({run_url}) did not complete: {status}.'
